queries: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) c) AS ratio_to_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count * 1.0) FROM s) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM s ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) c) AS ratio_to_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count is the mean of per-station telescope counts across stations that have at least one telescope (equal to total telescopes / number of such stations).
Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily because the request gives no tie-break.
